newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 3,000T pork for Oct shipment.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 3,000T pork for Oct shipment.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation (NLCF) invited tenders for 3,000 tonnes of pork by 4:00 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Tuesday, traders said.
Traders said the NLCF invited tenders for 1,500 tonnes of collar and 1,500 tonnes of picnic.

They said the tenders were divided into two parts: the first of 1,800 tonnes for shipment on October 18 -- 800 tonnes of collar and 1,000 tonnes of picnic -- and the second of 1,200 tonnes for shipment on October 31 -- 700 tonnes of collar and 500 tonnes of picnic.
Arrivals were set for Seoul and Pusan.
